description: The backup.pruned event, fired by the service after a non-dry backup.prune removed at least one file (a dry run is not an act and fires nothing; a prune that kept everything fires no event): the count and the files' NAMES — basenames, the fence's own voice, the one string content the payload carries. This is the event the pre-migration hook's post-success prune pointed at (T5): the daemon's prune path owns it, so every fenced removal in the family announces itself the same way. Daemon-wide.
